findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, breaking log assertions
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext(ctx) returns NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver. LoggerMiddleware.logRequest now calls m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so any test that injects a *TestLogger and then asserts on InfoLogs.Calls/Message/Ctx will observe zero recorded calls, since the log goes to a throwaway instance. Return `f` (or propagate recorded logs) so logging through FromContext remains observable; otherwise existing/future logger middleware tests silently stop validating anything.

findings.title: traceID no longer guaranteed in plugin request log
findings.body: The explicit `traceID` log param (from tracing.TraceIDFromContext) was removed and now depends entirely on the contextual logger installed by ContextualLoggerMiddleware, which does not add a traceID attribute. If the infra logger's FromContext does not inject the trace ID (or if the contextual attributes were never set, e.g. for stream endpoints), the 'Plugin Request Completed' log loses trace correlation, which is a regression for debugging.

findings.title: Stream endpoints get no contextual logger attributes
findings.body: SubscribeStream/PublishStream/RunStream pass the context through without calling instrumentContext, so logs emitted downstream for streaming calls lack pluginId/endpoint/dsUID/uname attributes. Since this middleware exists solely to attach the contextual logger, these endpoints silently lose all contextual log fields.

findings.title: Test name and missing test for new ContextualLoggerMiddleware
findings.body: The test function is still named TestInstrumentationMiddleware after the rename to MetricsMiddleware, and the newly extracted ContextualLoggerMiddleware (which now owns instrumentContext) has no test coverage verifying the contextual attributes are added to the context for each endpoint.
